SELECT ts.id AS session_id, COALESCE(f.workout_start_at, w.start_at, ts.anchor_start_at) AS workout_start_at, COALESCE(ts.anchor_end_at, w.end_at) AS anchor_end_at, COALESCE(f.duration_seconds, w.duration_seconds, MAX(0, (julianday(COALESCE(ts.anchor_end_at, w.end_at)) - julianday(COALESCE(f.workout_start_at, w.start_at, ts.anchor_start_at))) * 86400)) AS duration_seconds, COALESCE(f.distance_km, ts.anchor_distance_km, ( SELECT CASE stat.unit WHEN 'km' THEN stat.sum_value WHEN 'm' THEN stat.sum_value / 1000.0 WHEN 'mi' THEN stat.sum_value * 1.609344 ELSE stat.sum_value END FROM workout_statistics stat WHERE stat.workout_id = w.id AND stat.type = 'HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDistanceWalkingRunning' ORDER BY stat.ordinal LIMIT 1)) AS distance_km, COALESCE(f.average_heart_rate_bpm, ( SELECT stat.average_value FROM workout_statistics stat WHERE stat.workout_id = w.id AND stat.type = 'HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeartRate' ORDER BY stat.ordinal LIMIT 1)) AS average_heart_rate_bpm, f.missing_reasons_json, COALESCE(f.session_type, 'unclassified') AS session_type, COALESCE(zs.stimulus_type, 'unclassified') AS stimulus_type, zs.stimulus_confidence, COALESCE(f.eligibility_status, 'pending') AS eligibility_status, COALESCE(f.quality_score, 0) AS quality_score, w.id AS canonical_workout_id, w.indoor, w.source_category, a.assessment_status, a.current_ability, a.confidence, a.true_ability_delta, (a.id IS NOT NULL) AS analysis_available, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workout_routes wr WHERE wr.workout_id = w.id AND wr.point_count > 0 ) AS has_route FROM training_sessions ts JOIN workouts w ON w.id = ts.canonical_workout_id AND w.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN active_ability_assessments a ON a.training_session_id = ts.id LEFT JOIN workout_features f ON f.id = a.feature_id LEFT JOIN active_workout_zone_summaries zs ON zs.training_session_id = ts.id ORDER BY COALESCE(f.workout_start_at, w.start_at, ts.anchor_start_at) DESC, ts.id ASC LIMIT ?
